summary: Unidentified male visitor activated a SPOT device in the Keplinger Couloir area of Longs Peak with a lower-leg injury; rangers located him Saturday evening, stayed overnight, and he was flown by Flight For Life to Estes Park Medical Center on July 29, treated and released
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; Flight For Life Air Ambulance
notes: Incident reported within the July-31-2018 NPS release for the Brian Perri body recovery: a ranger responding to this SPOT activation found Perri's body southwest of the Mount Meeker summit. | run-831 NPT corroboration URL appended (parent-opened).
